summary: National Grid plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its half-year results press release for the period ended 30 September 2026, announced to the London Stock Exchange on 5 November 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. Headline figures: statutory operating profit GBP 2,359 million (up 55%), statutory profit before tax GBP 1,730 million, statutory EPS 26.9p, underlying EPS 36.5p (up 22%), and an interim dividend of 16.97p per share, 35% of the prior full-year dividend. Capital investment reached GBP 6,707 million, up 33%, with a GBP 70 billion five-year programme. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor named; the only capital-markets-adjacent items are non-recurring divestment effects noted within statutory results.
